title: New in Symfony 8.2: Validated and Compiled Expressions
content:
<html><head></head><body>The ExpressionLanguage component powers many Symfony features: the
#[IsGranted] and #[Cache] attributes, access_control rules, workflow
guards, and more. Symfony 8.2 makes these expressions faster, safer, and
reports their errors before they reach production.…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
